packet.decision_constraints: Test early frequency-only evidence; 6 s, 0.10 Hz/95% are prospective targets.
packet.supported_facts: Rife threshold versus local bounds; Kay 1989 abstract supports a simple comparator; generalized Kay supports a bounded lag sweep under coherence. H03/H05 distinguish uncertainty, presence and authority. Kay 1984 is a retrieval lead, not an implementable result.
packet.contrary_evidence_limits: Rife is stationary single-tone Gaussian; its original page locator exceeds logged access although the verifier independently confirmed the passage. No C/N0 conversion or accuracy is established.
packet.expert_question: Does a cheap matched Kay/lag/profile comparison separate acquisition tails from mismatch?
packet.cheapest_falsifier: Replay matched present/absent PCM with a small coherent lag set, report tail error, declines and false admissions; retunes invalidate coherence.
packet.consequential_rejections: Reject CRB or finite uncertainty as proof; defer repeated tuning and ranking.

stage_rows.support_locator: Paper excerpt pp. 593-596, especially explanation around pp. 595-596 that a distorted periodogram can place its global maximum far from the true tone and outliers then dominate MSE.
stage_rows.original_claim: A CRLB or small local fit residual is not enough to establish a useful early-acquisition error rate. Rife and Boorstyn describe rare low-SNR global-maximum outliers: ordinary errors can approach the bound while occasional large errors dominate total MSE below threshold.
stage_rows.original_operations_access: Only indexed excerpts logged; claimed page-specific direct access not demonstrated.
